title: Now-playing blocked host
description: One line of now-playing/blocked-hosts.ndjson.gz: a host that no now-playing request may reach, whatever adapter or template asks for it, including through a redirect. A client adds these to its own list; it never removes a host of its own because it is missing here.

host.description: Lowercase host name, no port, no trailing dot, never an IP literal.

subdomains.description: true: the host and every name ending in .host are blocked. false: this exact host only.

reason.description: station_request or service_request: asked to stop. robots_disallow: no longer given since 1.6 (terms and robots.txt never block), kept valid for older lists. refuses_user_agent: answers 403 to an identifiable User-Agent. maintainer: any other decision.
